milestone: SeLinOS Linux syscall ABI M10 FD 6 probe-local fstat record

contract.accepted_request: Only fstat(fd=6, one mapped user page) after the exact immutable /selinos-version open is accepted.
contract.record_layout: At user buffer offset 0 root writes u64 magic SELSTAT0 (0x53454c5354415430); at offset 8 it writes u64 immutable payload size 8; syscall result is zero.
contract.negative_scope: This is a SeLinOS probe-local two-word record, not Linux struct stat or statx. It provides no general descriptor, metadata, timestamp, permission, ownership, device, directory or persistent filesystem semantics.

required_markers: SeLinOS ABI M10: FD 6 probe-local two-word fstat record mediated; not Linux struct stat.
SeLinOS ABI M9: exact immutable /selinos-version open/read/close bridge mediated.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: bounded version fstat rejected.

not_claimed: Linux struct stat, statx or libc ABI compatibility
arbitrary file descriptors, dynamic descriptor table or post-close behavior
metadata, timestamps, permissions, ownership, device nodes, directories or symlinks
persistent filesystem, general VFS, package state database, dpkg or apt
